info.name: Abyssal Dreamwave
info.description: Abyssal Dreamwave is a soft, immersive style inspired by deep ocean aesthetics and dreamy anime visuals. It blends cool blue gradients, glowing highlights, and gentle motion-like depth to create a calm yet slightly mysterious atmosphere. Perfect for users who want a relaxing, futuristic, and visually rich browsing experience.
info.additionalInfo:
